Polish, and the fixes from testing v0.1.

- Fixed: the tile no longer sits on "Searching…" after a tap brings Wi-Fi back. It names the network as soon as Wi-Fi joins, and is up to date the moment the quick panel opens.
- One UI's words: "Wi-Fi" or "Mobile data" over the network name, as One UI's own tiles put it.
- One UI 9's mobile data arrows, and a Wi-Fi glyph matched to One UI's own.
- Motion: the tile's Wi-Fi arcs animate while it searches. In the panel, rows glide into place, the network you tap moves to the top with a spinner, and the sheet slides in, slides out, and follows the back gesture.
- New setup screen in One UI's style, with a live preview of your tile.

Needs Android 17 (One UI 9) and [Shizuku](https://shizuku.rikka.app/). Installs over v0.1.
